descriptionChirho: Qal sense describing literal physical height, tallness, or elevation of objects, persons, or natural features.
Qal sense of being exalted in status, dignity, or glory, often used of God or of persons elevated by God, with a positive connotation.
Qal sense of sinful pride or arrogance, where the heart or person is lifted up in self-exaltation against God or others.
Hifil causative sense of making something high, raising up, or exalting someone or something, including God who dwells on high.
Hifil sense used of birds or eagles soaring or flying at great height, a specialized extension of the causative 'make high' applied to flight.
